issues.explanation: No Pest/PHPUnit tests ship with the change despite new models, policies, middleware, routes and Livewire actions requiring happy-path plus unauthorized and tamper coverage.
Dashboard uses custom current_entity middleware without Livewire::addPersistentMiddleware, so Livewire update requests bypass the tenant check after the initial page load.
Pick, CurrentEntity middleware and Dashboard authorize via manual membershipFor checks instead of reusing EntityPolicy through Gate or authorize, duplicating policy logic outside app/Policies.
Entity creation writes directly inside the Livewire component instead of going through an app/Actions/* class that authorizes inside the action.
submit() never calls $this->authorize despite the Livewire rule to authorize every public action server-side.
Navbar queries memberships()->count() on every render without an @auth guard, risking null dereference for guests and adding a query per page.
Sets four request attributes plus two container instances for the same tenant instead of one canonical key.
Adds six lang keys with duplicated values for title and heading where switch_entity plus one title and one heading would suffice.

conventions.evidence: Follows #[Validate]+validate(), reversible migrations, $fillable, audit channel, docs/database-schema.md + CHANGELOG; deviates: manual membershipFor checks instead of policies/gates (EntityController.php:34, CurrentEntity.php:93, Dashboard.php:246), domain write in Livewire not app/Actions/* (CreateEntity.php:148), no Livewire::addPersistentMiddleware for current_entity

readability.evidence: Clear names, small focused methods, consistent style; drag: duplicate keys create_entity/onboarding_title/create_company vs create_entity_title/heading and four tenant aliases obscure the canonical one

requirements.evidence: Entity getRouteKeyName slug, entities_slug_unique + softDeletes, entity_memberships FKs + entity_memberships_entity_user_unique + owner_seq storedAs with entity_memberships_one_owner, both policies match task, uniqueSlug base then base-2 with retry on entities_slug_unique, pick 403 before session plus audit log, home/onboarding/switcher/pick/dashboard routes plus current_entity alias all present

scope.evidence: All hunks serve entities/memberships/session/onboarding/switcher/dashboard/docs/lang; no members/settings pages, invitations, queues, billing, locale middleware or navbar redesign

security.evidence: pick/middleware/dashboard abort 403, CreateEntity validates name and hardcodes Owner, {{ }} escaping, fillable deliberate; gaps: current_entity not persistent for Livewire updates and submit() without $this->authorize

simplicity.evidence: Lean reuse of route binding, Str::slug and existing layouts; extra: CurrentEntity.php:97-102 sets 4 attributes + 2 container instances, lang files add 6 keys for 3 needed strings

tests.evidence: change.diff adds no tests/* or Pest files; no happy-path, validation, unauthorized-call or tamper tests for CreateEntity/Dashboard/pick/middleware

review.summary: The change implements the full entity/tenant model, policies, onboarding with slug retry, tenant session, switcher and dashboard per the contract. It needs substantial rework before merge because it ships no tests and bypasses project conventions on policy-based authorization and persistent Livewire middleware.
